title: Wet Market Stall Regular
setting: The child helps at the family's vegetable stall in a wet market on weekends. A regular customer who chats every week followed the child's Instagram and messages about orders and school.

title: Cat Rescue Volunteer Teen
setting: Both volunteer at a small cat-rescue group that posts adoption notices. They message about feeding rotas and a kitten that needs fostering.

title: Tarot Reading Account
setting: The child followed an Instagram account that does free tarot and star-sign readings and asked a question about exams. The account owner replied by DM.
other_description: account owner, age unstated, writes like an adult

title: Dragon Boat Youth Crew
setting: Both paddle in a district youth dragon boat crew that trains at a typhoon shelter. They message about practice times, blisters and the coming race.
other_description: crew mate, 17, drummer of the boat

title: Birdwatching Society Junior
setting: The child joined a birdwatching society's junior outings in the wetlands. An adult volunteer who leads the walks messages about sightings and the next outing.

title: Classmate's Parent Carpool
setting: The child gets a lift to Saturday orchestra with a classmate. The classmate's parent, who drives, messages the child directly about pickup times because the classmate keeps forgetting.

title: Estate Stationery Shop Owner
setting: The child buys stationery and prints homework at a small shop in the housing estate. The shop owner followed the child after an online order for exam files.

title: Rhythm Game Arcade Regular
setting: Both play the same rhythm game at an arcade in a shopping mall after school and met in the queue. They message about scores, song unlocks and when the machine is free.

title: Elderly Home Visit Partner
setting: Both are paired in a school service scheme visiting an elderly home on Fridays. They message about what to bring and the residents they talk to.

title: Succulent Swap Group Teen
setting: The child grows succulents on the windowsill and joined an Instagram plant-swap circle. Another teen in the circle messages about cuttings and pots.

title: Prefect Team Senior
setting: The child was just made a junior prefect. A senior prefect who assigns duty posts messages about the duty roster and the prefects' camp.

title: Music Exam Accompanist
setting: The child is preparing for a graded violin exam and the teacher arranged a pianist to accompany. The accompanist messages to fix rehearsal times and tempo.

title: Outlying Island Ferry Friend
setting: Both live on an outlying island and take the same morning ferry to school in the city. They message about ferry delays, seats and homework on the boat.

title: Older Cousin's Partner
setting: The child's older cousin has a partner who comes to family dinners. After a family gathering the partner followed the child and messages about a game they both like.

title: Climbing Gym Belay Partner
setting: The child goes to a bouldering and climbing gym's youth sessions. A stronger teen who often partners with the child messages about routes and chalk.

title: Athletics Meet Rival
setting: The child runs the 800 metres and met a runner from another school at the inter-school heats. They message about times, spikes and the final.

title: Estate Night Run Pacer
setting: The child joined a free evening running group that loops the estate promenade. An adult who paces the slow group messages about routes and a charity 5k.

title: School Hall Tech Crew Senior
setting: The child joined the school hall's sound and lighting crew. A senior who runs the lighting desk messages about cue sheets for the annual drama night.

title: Phone Repair Shop Technician
setting: The child's phone screen was replaced at a small repair shop in a computer mall. The technician messages afterwards about the warranty and a cheap case.

title: Stargazing Camp Leader
setting: The child went to a weekend stargazing camp run by an astronomy group. One of the camp leaders messages about star charts, photos from the camp and the next meteor shower.
